# WebStore Dev

> Full stack web developer — complete websites and web apps that sell. Custom Next.js websites, admin panels, Cash on Delivery, WhatsApp ordering, and payment integration.

WebStore Dev (https://www.tarm.tech) is a web development service by Raza. Every website is custom-built with Next.js and React — fast, mobile-responsive, and SEO-friendly. Packages include an admin panel, shopping cart, checkout, and order management.

## Services

- [Full Stack Web Development](https://www.tarm.tech/services/full-stack-web-development) — complete full stack web application with product catalog, cart, checkout, order management and admin panel
- [Business Website](https://www.tarm.tech/services/business-website) — professional company website with services, portfolio, contact forms
- [Admin Panel](https://www.tarm.tech/services/admin-panel) — dashboard to add products, update prices, track orders yourself
- [Payment Integration](https://www.tarm.tech/services/payment-integration) — Stripe, PayPal, JazzCash, Easypaisa on your own merchant account
- [WhatsApp Ordering](https://www.tarm.tech/services/whatsapp-ordering) — one-tap ordering through WhatsApp chat
- [SEO Basics](https://www.tarm.tech/services/seo-basics) — search-friendly structure, fast loading, meta tags on every page

## Pricing (one-time)

- Starter Website: $80 — 5 pages, up to 20 products, mobile responsive, cart & checkout, Cash on Delivery, 5-day delivery, 7-day support
- Business Website: $150 (most popular) — 8 pages, up to 100 products, admin panel, WhatsApp ordering + COD, order notifications, 7-day delivery, 14-day support
- Pro Website: $300 — 12 pages, payment gateway integration, custom banners & branding, order email alerts, SEO basics, 10-day delivery, 30-day priority support

## Key facts

- Business: WebStore Dev — freelance web development service
- Website: https://www.tarm.tech
- Tech stack: Next.js, React, Turso (SQLite) database
- Delivery: Starter 5 days, Business 7 days, Pro 10 days
- Payments accepted: Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Stripe, PayPal, WhatsApp ordering, Binance Pay, Payoneer, USDT
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 325 8774221, email neilsonsmarry@gmail.com

- Post-launch: client can update products/prices/orders themselves via admin panel — no coding needed

## Common questions, answered

- What services does WebStore Dev offer? Custom full stack websites and web apps, business websites, admin panels, payment integration (Stripe/PayPal/JazzCash/Easypaisa), WhatsApp ordering, and SEO basics.
- How much does a website cost? Starter $80, Business $150, Pro $300 — one-time payment, no monthly fees to the developer.
- How long does it take to build a website? Starter: 5 days. Business: 7 days. Pro: 10 days.
- What technology is used? Next.js and React — fast, secure, and SEO-friendly.
- Can I update my website myself? Yes — Business and Pro include an admin panel for products, prices, and orders with no coding.
- Which payment methods can my store accept? Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Stripe, PayPal, and WhatsApp ordering — online gateways use your own merchant account.
- Will my website work on mobile? Yes — every site is fully mobile responsive.
- Do I need to buy domain and hosting? Yes, guided step by step (~$15/year); the site remains 100% yours.
- What should I ask before hiring a web developer? Ask about portfolio, tech stack, delivery time, total cost, who owns the domain/hosting, admin panel access, payment methods, mobile responsiveness, SEO basics, and post-launch support. Full checklist: https://www.tarm.tech/blog/questions-before-hiring-web-developer-2026
